stages.label: Vacuum Einstein equations
stages.establishes: The declared model uses G_mu_nu=0 in the exterior sector.

stages.label: Static spherical exterior
stages.establishes: The field equations integrate to f(r)=1-2m/r under the declared boundary normalization.

stages.label: Isotropic weak-field reduction
stages.establishes: Exact coordinate translation and formal series give beta=gamma=1.

stages.label: Cassini fitted parameter

stages.establishes: The exact prediction gamma-1=0 lies inside the displayed reported plus-minus band.

interfaces.basis: The reduced Einstein equation is an exact first-order ODE and the angular residual vanishes after substitution.
The areal-to-isotropic coordinate map is exact and the series coefficients are rational.
The Lorentzian null condition fixes the first-order coefficient 1+gamma.
Assumes minimally coupled radio photons follow metric null geodesics and imports the experiment's identification of its fitted gamma parameter.
Compares the exact theoretical value only with the publisher's displayed estimate; no raw-data or likelihood reconstruction is claimed.

field_equation_derivation.starting_equations: G_mu_nu=0 in the vacuum exterior; Lambda=0
field_equation_derivation.integration: (r f)'=1, hence f=1+C/r; Newtonian normalization fixes C=-2m
field_equation_derivation.scope: Exact within the static, spherically symmetric, asymptotically flat vacuum ansatz.

ppn_identification.template: g_tt=-1+2U-2 beta U^2+O(U^3); g_ij=(1+2 gamma U+O(U^2))delta_ij

empirical_comparison_rail.citation: B. Bertotti, L. Iess, and P. Tortora, A test of general relativity using radio links with the Cassini spacecraft, Nature 425, 374-376 (2003).
empirical_comparison_rail.boundary: The arithmetic comparison is exact after transcription. The spacecraft data reduction, plasma correction, covariance model, and likelihood are imported from the paper and are not reproduced.

maturity_rails.basis: Every exact stage uses the same declared standard-GR solar-exterior model and mass parameter.
All 3 obligations required by this bounded prediction are satisfied; other obligations are explicitly masked.
All 5 joins are registered: 3 exact and 2 literature-scoped operational/comparison joins.
The exact field-equation, coordinate, PPN, and null-condition chain gives gamma=1 and gamma+1=2.
The fitted Cassini gamma is connected to the null-delay coefficient under the declared photon-coupling and experimental-model assumptions.
gamma-1=0 lies in the publisher's displayed (2.1+/-2.3)e-5 band.
No second solar-system dataset or held-out comparison is included in this assembly.
